ayahs.1: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah. He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
ayahs.2: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death. He is capable of everything.
ayahs.3: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. He has perfect knowledge of everything.
ayahs.4: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then established Himself on the Kursi—Allah's Footstool, symbol of His dominion over creation. He knows what enters the earth and what emerges from it, what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees everything you do.
ayahs.5: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah all matters are returned.
ayahs.6: He merges night into day and day into night. He knows best what is in every heart.
ayahs.7: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend from what He has made you trustees over. Those among you who have iman and spend will have a great reward.
ayahs.8: What is the matter with you that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to have iman in your Rabb, and He has already taken your pledge—if you are truthful?
ayahs.9: He is the One who sends down clear ayahs to His servant, to bring you out of darkness into light. Allah is truly Most Kind to you, the Rahim.
ayahs.10: Why do you not spend in Allah's cause, when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those among you who spent and fought before the victory are not equal to those who did so later. They have a greater rank—but to all Allah has promised the finest reward. Allah is fully aware of what you do.
ayahs.11: Who will lend Allah a good loan, so He may multiply it for them and they will have a generous reward?
ayahs.12: On the Day you see believing men and women with their light running before them and to their right, they will be told: Good news for you today—Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to remain forever. That is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.13: On that Day hypocrite men and women will say to the mu'min: Wait for us so we may borrow some of your light. They will be told: Go back and seek light elsewhere. Then a wall with a gate will be set between them. Inside are Allah's mercy; outside, His punishment.
ayahs.14: They will call to them: Were we not with you? They will reply: Yes—but you led yourselves into temptation, waited too long, doubted, and false hopes deceived you until Allah's decree came. And the deceiver—Satan—deceived you about Allah.
ayahs.15: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from those who rejected the truth. Your home is the Fire—it is your only fitting refuge. What an evil destination!
ayahs.16: Has the time not come for those who have iman for their hearts to humble themselves at Allah's remembrance and at what has been revealed of the truth, and not be like those who were given the Book before—whose hearts grew hard over time, and many of them became rebellious?
ayahs.17: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have made the signs clear to you so perhaps you will understand.
ayahs.18: Those who give in charity—men and women—and lend Allah a good loan will have it multiplied for them, and they will have a generous reward.
ayahs.19: Those who have iman in Allah and His messengers—they are the truthful and the witnesses with their Rabb. They will have their reward and their light. As for those who rejected and denied Our ayahs, they are the people of Hell.
ayahs.20: Know that this dunya is only play, distraction, adornment, boasting among yourselves, and rivalry in wealth and children—like rain whose growth delights farmers, then it withers and you see it yellow, then it crumbles to dust. In the Akhirah there is severe punishment, forgiveness from Allah, and His pleasure. The life of this dunya is nothing but the enjoyment of delusion.
ayahs.21: Race toward forgiveness from your Rabb and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who have iman in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah—He gives it to whom He wills. Allah's bounty is immense.
ayahs.22: No disaster strikes the earth or yourselves except that it is already written in a Record before We bring it into being. That is easy for Allah—
ayahs.23: so you do not grieve over what you missed nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love every self-important boaster,
ayahs.24: those who are stingy and urge stinginess on others. Whoever turns away—Allah is the Self-Sufficient, the Praised.
ayahs.25: We sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance of justice, so people may uphold equity. We sent down iron, in which is great might and benefit for people, so Allah may know who supports Him and His messengers unseen. Allah is Strong, Almighty.
ayahs.26: We sent Noah and Abraham and established prophethood and scripture among their descendants. Some were guided; many were rebellious.
ayahs.27: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. We sent Jesus son of Mary and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of his followers. As for monasticism—they invented it; We did not prescribe it for them except to seek Allah's pleasure, yet they did not observe it as they should. So We gave those among them who had iman their reward, but many of them were rebellious.
ayahs.28: O you who have iman: Have taqwa of Allah and believe in His Messenger. He will give you a double portion of His mercy, grant you a light to walk by, and forgive you. Allah is All-Forgiving, the Rahim.
ayahs.29: This is so the People of the Book may know they have no power over any of Allah's bounty, and that all bounty is in Allah's Hand. He gives it to whom He wills. Allah's bounty is immense.
